im 14

consider me 8 tho :''''''(

I am very good at rushing. Especially when coordinating with others to make a push, and will easily sacrifice myself for another. I am also excellent at bridging, i can bleeple, ninjabridge, faststack, and some other diagoal shtuff. I am very experienced with block palcement(on point), and get 10+ cps when bridging :P

Using my ping, i can get nutty combos on people, with or without good gear. Somehow, i always find myslelf being good at close bow pvp.alike in real life, i can evade situations and sneak out from behind.im think im underrated just a little bit.

and yes, i do speak toxic mineman
